data_flow.description: User provides project directory and options via CLI arguments
Scans project directory to build file fragments and directory tree
Passes directory tree to LLM for key file identification
LLM returns list of important files to analyze
Assembles context with tree and selected file contents
Sends full context to LLM for graph generation
LLM returns structured JSON graph data
Converts graph to Markdown and JSON files

test_organization.covers: CLI argument parsing and command execution
Two-pass prompt assembly and file filtering logic
Integration tests for LLM interaction and end-to-end flows

architecture_notes.note: Two-pass LLM strategy: Pass 1 sends only directory tree to identify key files, Pass 2 sends tree + selected files for comprehensive analysis
Security-first design: System prompt includes injection guards treating file content as data only
Secret redaction: Scanner automatically excludes sensitive files and redacts secret-like patterns from content
OpenAI-compatible API: Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, not just OpenAI
Pydantic v2 validation: All LLM responses validated against strict schema models
Exponential backoff retry: LLM calls include retry logic with exponential backoff for resilience
Token estimation: Uses heuristic of ~4 UTF-8 bytes per token for context window management
